Languages: After years of dedicated learning, completing various courses, and working on diverse projects, I have gained proficiency in multiple programming languages and frameworks, particularly in the field of front-end development.

tabs.title: My Story
tabs.content: I was born and raised in a small town in western Iran, but I spent a decade living in Tehran, the capital of Iran. My passion for adventure led me to travel extensively and experience life in various countries and cities across the heart of Africa. After years of exploring new places and cultures, I decided to permanently move to Canada, and I have been living in Vancouver for over a year now.

tabs.title: My Hobbies
tabs.content: In my free time, I enjoy kayaking and hiking, activities that allow me to stay connected with nature. I also find great joy in writing stories and playing the traditional instrument, the kamancheh. Additionally, I am passionate about front-end development.
